builds_on: LOCK 5 (clothes and bags), LOCK 9 (secret giving after page 1), LOCK 23 Saeed, LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 36 roads. Founder 8 Nov picks: animals, land and buildings, businesses, waqf; marriage and family (scholar check set aside 9 Nov).

missions.title: Marriage
missions.button: Idris wants to talk about your future

a.text: Idris pours tea. “You have a house now, and River Market speaks well of you. Have you thought of marriage? Half the religion, they say.”

choices.label: Ask whom he has in mind
Ask whom he has in mind

man.text: “Layla's niece, Aisha. She keeps the accounts for Layla's looms and reads better than I do. If you agree, I'll speak to Layla.”

choices.label: Ask him to speak to Layla

woman.text: “A young man has spoken to your uncle: Ammar, the copyist at the House of Learning. Honest, prays at the masjid, works hard. Your uncle asked me what I think. I think well of him.”

choices.label: Agree to meet him with your uncle

meet.text: The families meet in Layla's courtyard, with everyone present. There are questions about prayer, work, and where you would live. Then the question is put plainly: yes or no?

mahr.text: The mahr is agreed: thirty coins, given to the bride, hers to keep. The nikah will be at the masjid after Asr, with Idris and Rashid as witnesses.

nikah.text: In the masjid the words are said, the witnesses agree, and Idris makes du'a for you both. Outside, Faris and the quay boys are throwing dates in the air.

choices.label: A wedding feast for the market · 20 coins
A small feast for the family · 5 coins

walima.text: The feast goes on until Maghrib. That night the house by the canal has two people in it.

later.text: Idris smiles. “There's no hurry. When you're ready.”

walima: Fed the whole market at their wedding
